rationale: The request presents workflow-level continuity friction: timeout and retry can erase entered work, navigation context, and request identity. With modification expressly prohibited, Redesign is the correct mode. The response supplies a coherent replacement lifecycle covering durable identity, staged state, idempotent submission, timeout reconciliation, adjacent recovery, accessibility feedback, and verification scenarios. Read-only inspection observed only the blocked fixture state, and identical before/after hashes corroborate that no modification was attempted. The response appropriately distinguishes the supplied requirements, observed fixture evidence, inferred design, and unresolved feasibility questions without claiming real-world validation.
